pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.purpose: Move through discrete pages of one bounded result set with numbered controls and ellipsis collapse, without owning filtering, sorting, table state, or infinite loading patterns.

anatomy.rule: Shows local component status. Selected/current page uses Flow action-primary.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

variants.description: Numbered page switcher with ellipsis collapse and selected/current page using Flow action-primary plus ZIP-informed depth and bounded motion.

Energy.decision: Use Flow action-primary for selected/current page; ZIP informs treatment, depth, and motion.
Energy.behavior: Pagination exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Energy.test: Verify selected/current page uses Flow action-primary.
Energy.rejectIf: Selected/current page uses raw color or non-Flow active/current color.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Accepted for API alignment; Pagination renders the numbered variant.

props.name: density
props.notes: Density scale for the numbered controls.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the pagination row to fill its parent width.

props.name: onPageChange
props.notes: Called when a local page request changes.

do: Use Pagination for its bounded job.
dont: Filtering, sorting, table ownership, search results, and infinite loading behavior belong to patterns.
Do not mix numbered pagination and infinite loading in the component.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.

tests: Selected/current page uses Flow action-primary with ZIP-informed depth and momentum
agentInstructions: Use Pagination only for local component behavior.
Data table, search result, sorting, and infinite loading behavior belong to patterns.
rejectIf: Filtering, sorting, table ownership, search results, and infinite loading behavior belong to patterns.

semanticDecisions.decision: Use sys.energy action-primary for selected/current page.
semanticDecisions.zipInfluence: Numbered structure, mono numerals, chevrons, depth, and selected-page momentum.
